messages:
Leah: opened PR #4723 — docs tidy for function/tool calling + structured output. Goals: 1) fix two dead anchors, 2) standardize call envelope, 3) add parse-fallback recipe and runnable snippets. PTAL :mag:

Tom: can you paste the broken anchors?

Leah: yeah: /docs/calls.md#old-return and /docs/schema-playbook.md#list-nullable. PR adds redirects and updates internal links. We recommend envelope -> {"action": "name", "args": {...}} to avoid ambiguous top-level keys.

Ben: I'll update the TypeScript examples to use `makeCallEnvelope(action, args)`. Also adding a tiny parser example for union-wrapped arrays.

Kai: I'll do the python snippet changes — adding `structured_output()` helper and a short test that coerces string -> list and null -> [] per the fallback recipe.

Leah: parse-fallback recipe in PR: 1) validate with JSON Schema; 2) coerce obvious mismatches (string "1,2" -> [1,2], single number -> [n]); 3) fallback to safe default and emit telemetry. Small runnable examples included.

docs-bot: CI: build-docs ✅, link-checker ✅, docs-tests -> 1 failing (tests from Ben pending).

Tom: let's land redirects first so link-checker stays green. Ben/Kai please push snippets + tests this sprint.

Ben: pushing TS snippets in 30m. I included tests covering: proper envelope, stringified array, null, and wrapper object.

Kai: pushed py snippets and a docs-test that asserts normalized args. Re-requesting review.

Leah: thanks — re-requesting reviewers. Will merge after approvals and ask merge-bot to schedule the docs deploy. :rocket:
